text: That device needs someone signed in at its keyboard. A remote session doesn't count. It would work on an unlocked PC with nobody watching, which is why you lock your screen when you step away. Now scan the file server.
style: Security lead on Merrin & Sallow's outsourced IT provider (Fenlow Managed IT), in her 40s, warm and practical. Speak with a consistent London and southern English accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent.
